description: Stamp page numbers on every page: position (6 places), style (1 / Page 1 / Page 1 of N / - 1 -), first number, text size, optional no number on the cover page. Runs on our server, files are deleted right after the call, nothing stored. Free: 25 calls/day per IP. Paid: $0.005 per call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/pdf-page-numbers.

fileContent.description: The file as base64 (a data: URI is fine)

fileName.description: File name with extension, e.g. report.pdf

format.description: n = 1, page = Page 1, of = Page 1 of N, dash = - 1 -

position.description: bc bottom center, br, bl, tc top center, tr, tl

skipFirst.description: No number on the first page (cover)

name: pdf_page_numbers
title: PDF Page Numbers API - add page numbers to a PDF
